name: Union Hall
notes: StartupCincy Week hub and daily check-in. SCW FAQ: "All attendees should check in each day at Union Hall (1311 Vine Street) before heading to sessions or events at other locations." Cintrifuse: "Sitting at the center of Cincinnati’s vibrant and historic Over-the-Rhine district, Union Hall serves as the bustling hub of our startup ecosystem. With 38,000 square feet of private offices, coworking, and event space ..." Event rooms listed by Cintrifuse: Beer Hall (seats up to 200), Homeroom, conference rooms (6–10 people); members also get a private rooftop. Coworking day pass: "$25 / day / person". Soapbox (2026-09-15): the week "still uses Union Hall as a central gathering place, but its footprint has expanded into multiple blocks in Over-the-Rhine." Same id as the scw-agenda slice. Coordinates: Nominatim "Union Hall, 1311, Vine Street, Vine Street Business District, Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, 45202, United States". StartupCincy Week hub and daily check-in. SCW FAQ: "All attendees should check in each day at Union Hall (1311 Vine Street) before heading to sessions or events at other locations." Parking per the FAQ: Mercer Commons Garage (1310 Vine Street) or Washington Park Garage (1230 Elm Street); no parking validation. The agenda gives no room or venue per session, so only sessions whose own text names Union Hall (room "Beer Hall") or whose official host/application page names it (Cintrifuse Annual Meeting: cintrifuse.com; Student Pitch Competition: the SCW application form) are linked here. Linked events: 4. Coordinates from Nominatim: "Union Hall, 1311, Vine Street, Vine Street Business District, Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, 45202, United States". StartupCincy Week home base (see scw-info / scw-agenda venues). Hub for walking-distance calculations. A room inside Union Hall (parent venue: union-hall), not a separate building. Cintrifuse: "Perfect for a full or half day seminar, our Beer Hall seats up to 200 guests. The space includes a projector and screen, accommodating large presentations." 2026 agenda: "SUCW 2026 Kickoff!" (Oct 5, "Join us LIVE! from Beer Hall at Union Hall") and "SUCW Student Day Kickoff!" (Oct 8, "Union Hall - Beer Hall").

name: Cincinnati Art Week HQ + Art Market (1417 Main St)
notes: Names used: "new headquarters at 1417 Main St." (CityBeat); "Cincinnati Art Week Temporary HQ + Art Market" (Cincy Nice Founding Circle page); "Cincinnati Art Week Art Market" (Eventbrite, which gives ZIP 45206 and lat 39.1118189, lng -84.5126129). Office hours + artist co-working 11AM–3PM Mon–Wed. NO GRID starts here. Geocode: Nominatim (OSM ZIP 45202). Art Week HQ as recorded by the caw slice (same id as research/caw/venues.json). Hub for walking-distance calculations. Sessions "Out of Office: Fresh Perspectives" (Oct 5 and Oct 7): "This session will meet at the Cincinnat Art Week HQ!" (sic). The SCW site gives no address. The organizer's own page (Cincy Nice, https://www.cincynice.com/founding-circle-rsvp) gives "Location: 1417 Main St. Cincinnati Art Week Temporary HQ + Art Market", and CityBeat (Aug 4 2026) reports Art Week's "new headquarters at 1417 Main St. in Over-the-Rhine" (https://www.citybeat.com/arts/visual-arts/cincinnati-arts-week-launches-october/). Not to be confused with the Art Week Welcome Center / hub at 1600 Race St. (Cincinnati Magazine, Sep 23 2026, https://www.cincinnatimagazine.com/article/cincinnati-art-week/). Same place as the caw slice venue "caw-art-market-hq-1417-main". Linked events: 2. Coordinates from Nominatim: "1417, Main Street, Main Street Business District, Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati, Hamilton County, Ohio, 45202, United States".
